description: Twelve original TorchRec row-wise diagrams, preserving message/actor/trace detail; three pipeline diagrams. Trace activity numbers and sizes are sample observations, not source guarantees. render-torchrec-diagrams.py adds source-grounded transfer/synchronization detail.

diagrams.title: Row-wise ShardedEmbeddingCollection: module topology
diagrams.subtitle: Forward per row-wise group: input 3 + output 1 = 4 AllToAll calls (multi-rank, fixed-stride, unweighted KJT).

rows.label: input_dist(ctx, KJT)
rows.detail: feature reorder + optional unique

rows.label: _input_dists[row_wise](features)
rows.detail: bucketize rows by owner rank

rows.label: _dist(bucketized_features)
rows.detail: Input stage totals 3 AllToAll calls: splits now; lengths + ID values at the first wait below.
rows.tag_detail: 3 AllToAll calls: splits + lengths + ID values

rows.label: wait().wait() -> received KJT
rows.detail: First wait: read receive sizes, launch lengths + ID values AllToAll. Second wait: consume payload and recat the KJT.

rows.label: _lookups[row_wise](received KJT)
rows.detail: BatchedFusedEmbedding -> FBGEMM TBE

rows.label: _output_dists[row_wise](embeddings)
rows.detail: 1 AllToAll call: return embedding vectors to requesting ranks via SequenceEmbeddingsAllToAll.

rows.label: return SequenceEmbeddingsAwaitable
rows.detail: wrapped by EmbeddingCollectionAwaitable

rows.label: wait()
rows.detail: unbucketize unique rows; then reverse_indices restores duplicates

notes: IN and OUT summarize module stages. Count per rank, per row-wise group: 3 input + 1 output = 4 forward AllToAll collective calls.
The input total spans _dist() and the first wait. Backward gradient communication is separate. Weights or variable stride add payload tensors.
Counts refer to PyTorch collective calls using the NCCL backend; they do not count NCCL send/recv primitives or GPU kernels.
Nested lookup modules not compressed here: GroupedEmbeddingsLookup -> BatchedFusedEmbedding -> SplitTableBatchedEmbeddingBagsCodegen.
KJTAllToAllSplitsAwaitable and KJTAllToAllTensorsAwaitable are Awaitable objects, not nn.Module instances.
Activity IDs, sizes, kernel names and optimizer details illustrate one execution configuration; they are not fixed for every run.
